items.entity: cantilever design domain (length L x height H / aspect ratio)
items.description: Sec. 2.1 refers to Fig. 1 for the beam geometry, and Sec. 4 gives only hexagon counts (HNelx=120, HNey=60, from HoneyMesher [9]). No physical dimensions, hexagon size or hexagon orientation are stated. Staggered honeycomb rows mean L/H is not simply 120:60, so the aspect ratio cannot be determined from the text.
readings: L:H = 2:1 (treat the 120x60 counts as square cells)
L:H ~ 2.31:1 (regular hexagons with vertical sides: horizontal pitch sqrt(3)a, row pitch 1.5a)
L:H ~ 1.73:1 (regular hexagons with horizontal sides: horizontal pitch 1.5a, vertical pitch sqrt(3)a)

items.entity: structured-grid stand-in for the 120x60 honeycomb (hexagonal-element) mesh
items.description: Table 2 (M=1 SIMP, C=2.49342) was computed on HoneyMesher hexagonal elements (Sec. 1, Sec. 4, Fig. 1). The text does not give the element shape or formulation (shape functions, integration), and there is no exact quad-grid equivalent. The grid size and element type for a structured-grid solver are therefore not fixed.
readings: 120 x 60 square bilinear Q4 elements (one quad per hexagon)
quad grid at about the same pitch matching the chosen aspect ratio (e.g. 139x60 or 120x52 for ~2.31:1; 104x60 for ~1.73:1)
refined grid (e.g. 240x120) with the filter radius doubled

items.entity: concentrated point load at the lower-right corner
items.description: Sec. 2.1 ('point load at the free end') and the Fig. 1 caption ('lower-right corner') give only the location. The direction appears only as the load arrow in Fig. 1, which is not available.
readings: vertical downward (-y), the usual cantilever case
vertical upward (+y), which gives the same layout and compliance as -y
horizontal (+x or -x)

items.description: No load value is given anywhere. The reported C=2.49342 (Table 2, M=1, SIMP) scales with |F|^2. With F=1, E=1 and t=1, beam theory gives C of at least about 20 for a solid cantilever with aspect ratio of 1.7 or more (about 32 for 2:1). The reported value therefore implies an unstated load, modulus or thickness scaling, or a normalized compliance.
readings: |F| = 1 (unit load)
an unstated load magnitude or compliance normalization (only rescales C by |F|^2)

items.entity: volume fraction V_f for the single-material extended SIMP case (M=1)
items.description: Eq. (1) defines V_fm, and the abstract and Sec. 1 mention 'prescribed volume fractions', but Sec. 4 and Tables 2-3 give no numeric value for any case, including M=1.

items.entity: Young's modulus of the single solid material (and void stiffness Emin)
items.description: Only normalized moduli are given. Table 1 sets phase 1 (Black) to E=1 and void to 1e-9. Eq. (14), E_bar_0,i=(i-1)/(N_MP-1), runs in the opposite order, gives 0 rather than 1e-9 for its lowest phase, and is 0/0 when N_MP=1. For M=1 the sensible reading is E1=1 and Emin=1e-9, but no dimensional reference modulus is stated.
readings: E1 = 1, Emin = 1e-9 (normalized, Table 1 phase 1)
E1 = E0 with an unstated dimensional reference modulus, Emin = 1e-9*E0 (C scales as 1/E0)

items.description: Not given anywhere. Sec. 3.0.1 and Table 1 list only Young's moduli, but a 2D linear-elastic element stiffness needs nu.

items.entity: 2D constitutive assumption (plane stress vs plane strain)
items.description: Sec. 2.1 says only 'two-dimensional cantilever beam'. Plane stress versus plane strain is never stated, and this changes the effective constitutive matrix, not just its scale.
readings: plane stress
plane strain

items.description: Thickness is not stated. It scales all element stiffnesses uniformly, so it only rescales the compliance.
readings: another unstated thickness (C proportional to 1/t)

items.description: Eq. (4) and Sec. 3.0.1 introduce p, and Sec. 4 says all optimization parameters are kept the same. No value or continuation scheme is given.
readings: p = 3 (constant)
p increased from 1 to 3

items.description: Sec. 4 sets r_fill = 4 with no unit. On the honeycomb mesh it is unclear whether this means element (centroid) pitches, hexagon side lengths or HoneyMesher coordinate units. The equivalent radius in structured-grid elements is therefore not fixed.
readings: 4.0 element widths
~2.31 element widths (4 hexagon side lengths, with side = pitch/sqrt(3))

items.entity: density-filter weights W_ej, neighborhood and boundary treatment
items.description: Eq. (2) leaves W_ej undefined; Sec. 2.2.1 says only 'classical density-filtering technique'. The weight function, whether the cutoff is d<r or d<=r, and the treatment at domain edges are not stated.
readings: linear cone W_ej = max(0, r - d_ej) on centroid distances, no padding (top88-style)
Gaussian weights truncated at r

items.description: Sec. 4 says only that beta 'starts with 1 and increases up to beta_max = 32'. The increment rule (doubling or additive) and how often it is applied (fixed iterations or on convergence) are not stated.
readings: double beta every 50 iterations (1,2,4,8,16,32)
double beta every 25 iterations
double beta when max|dx| drops below a tolerance (e.g. 0.01)

items.entity: density field used in the volume constraint
items.description: Eq. (1) writes V(x)_m in terms of the design variables x, but Sec. 2.2.1 uses the projected x_phys in the stiffness interpolation. With Heaviside projection these volumes differ, and the text does not say which one is constrained.
readings: constraint on the projected physical densities x_phys
constraint on the design variables x (literal reading of Eq. 1)
constraint on the filtered densities x_tilde

items.description: The abstract and Sec. 1 state only that MMA is used. Move limits, asymptote parameters and any objective or constraint scaling are not given.
readings: Svanberg's standard MMA defaults (asyinit 0.5, asyincr 1.2, asydecr 0.7), no extra move limit
MMA with an external move limit of 0.1-0.2 and the objective scaled by the initial compliance
GCMMA

items.description: No stopping rule or iteration cap is given (Sec. 4). This interacts with the unstated beta schedule, so it also decides whether beta actually reaches 32.
readings: stop when max|dx| < 0.01 after beta reaches 32
fixed iteration budget (e.g. 300 or 500 iterations)
stop when the relative change in C < 1e-4

items.description: The starting values of the design variables are not stated anywhere.
readings: uniform x = V_f
uniform x = 0.5
uniform x = 1

locator: Sec. 2.1 / Sec. 4, the cantilever beam of Fig. 1, single-material extended SIMP case
